neighbours.label: Phrases introducing how something is done: instrumental 'by' and French 'de façon' manner constructions.
fire: During the inspection, the mechanic reduced vibration by tightening the loose screws.
For a smoother sauce, the cook removed the remaining lumps by stirring steadily.
In this experiment, researchers identified damaged cells by measuring changes in their outer membranes.
Before publication, the editor shortened the article by deleting several repetitive paragraphs.
The report describes the process by which the filter removes fine particles from drinking water.
For the historian, these letters reveal the channels by which rumors spread across the kingdom.
Dans cette application, les utilisateurs peuvent modifier leurs préférences de façon simple et rapide.
Pendant la réunion, la directrice a présenté les résultats de façon claire et précise.
quiet: At the workshop, tightening the loose screws reduced vibration in the machine.
During dinner preparations, steady stirring removed the remaining lumps from the sauce.
The laboratory team measured changes in outer membranes, identifying the damaged cells.
During the final revision, deleting several repetitive paragraphs shortened the article.
The technical report describes the filter's removal of fine particles from drinking water.
The historian's account traces rumors spreading across the kingdom along several channels.
Sur cette plateforme, la modification des préférences reste simple et rapide pour les utilisateurs.
Devant ses collègues, la directrice a donné une présentation claire et précise des résultats.
